notes.title: Reality Capture Update! November 2021
notes.content:
For November we rolled out the Reality Capture mechanic!  Press T to capture images and data about your current reality!  Press V to view images you have captured.  To Restore the tower, you must gather at least 10 data captures from different realities.  

Fixes : 
Tutorial revamped to prevent house placement from looking out of place.  
Menus further cleaned up and missing tool tips corrected.
The new T and V keys are listed on the control screens (Press Y to toggle menus)
Digging graphic improved to be more visually accurate and smoother.
Slight performance improvements.

Press V to view images you have captured.

notes.title: Reality Creation update - Complete
notes.content:
Our multi part update is now complete.  This update aimed to add more things to the world and more things to do.  

*Crystals 
The deepest block type can be spent in many new ways.  Some enhance your character, and some enhance your ability to alter the look of the world.  Look at your skill book pages to explore them!

*New enemy type 
The Dark Matter can only be stopped by trapping it in a light box (a new unlockable placement item).

*Visual improvements and additions, new mountains are settled in.

*Many UI enhancements, to help make the UI more usable.

tags.feature: *Crystals The deepest block type can be spent in many new ways. Some enhance your character, and some enhance your ability to alter the look of the world. Look at your skill book pages to explore them!
*New enemy type The Dark Matter can only be stopped by trapping it in a light box (a new unlockable placement item).
*Visual improvements and additions, new mountains are settled in.
*Many UI enhancements, to help make the UI more usable.
